title: Stereo card of New Haven Union Station (NYPL b11707673-G90F065 024ZF)
blurb: * Numbered: 18, 35, 39, 64, 77. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Views of New Haven, Connecticut: includes general and street views; views of parks, including several views of "the Green"; churches; buildings at Yale including Art, "Old" Scientific, "New" Scientific, and general views; the railroad station; a view at Savin Rock; cast metal crane sculptures gracing a large lawn at [Fernhurst]; portraits of a man, a woman and two small children taken by a New Haven photographer.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.2% vertical error and 0.03° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (1.55% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
